test_assert_close: test two PyTorch tensors are element-wise equal within a specified tolerance
test_assert_equal: test two PyTorch tensors are exactly element-wise equal with zero tolerance
test_has_no_inf: test a PyTorch tensor has no positive or negative infinite elements
test_has_no_nan: test a PyTorch tensor has no NaN elements
test_temporary_manual_seed: test setting a temporary manual seed on RNGs for specific devices
